tier: Rotating Residential (per GB) and ISP Proxies (per IP)

free_tier.stated: No standing free tier with a stated size. The home page carries 'Free Trial for New Users' beside 'Buy Now'; the trial's size and duration are not stated on the pages read.
free_tier.notes: The sign-up and console pages did not return readable content.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a traffic plan or an address, not an object

retention.stated: Rotating residential traffic: 'Traffic Never Expires'. ISP proxies: 'Exclusive IP' for the validity period with 'Unlimited Bandwidth'.

egress.terms: Residential is 'Pay-As-You-Go' per GB; ISP proxies and datacenter proxies are priced per IP, the ISP page stating 'Unlimited Bandwidth'.
egress.free_allowance: a trial of unstated size for new users

interface_detail: Forward proxy ('Full protocol support'), API integration and a proxy manager are advertised. The protocols were not enumerated on the pricing pages read.
tooling: Any client that speaks an HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy with credentials, or the vendor's API.
chaining: The vendor's gateway is an HTTP or SOCKS5 forward proxy, so it is dialled from a host that can open outbound proxy connections (a rented or free virtual machine); the upstream then sees an address from the vendor's pool instead of the host's own.

limits.value: rotating residential from 1 USD per GB, traffic never expires; ISP proxies from 2.5 USD per IP; datacenter proxies from 4.5 USD per IP

limits_note: The vendor also publishes time-limited sale pages with lower promotional prices; they are not used as the price. Pool claims: more than 90 million residential IPs in 190+ regions, 'Unlimited concurrent requests', 0.6 s average response.
binding_note: The purchased GB is the quantity that runs out; the ISP product is per IP and has no byte limit.

identity_cost.detail: The terms state 'You may use the email address you provided or confirmed, or other methods permitted by IPFLY, to log in to the website.' No ID document or card is requested before checkout on the pages read; the payment-method icons on the page footer are PayPal, Visa, USDT and Alipay. The registration form itself was not readable.

reliability_note: The refund agreement says 'refunds are not supported in principle' once delivery is complete, with a 24-hour exception for a total technical failure. The vendor publishes 99.9% availability; unverified here.
confidence_note: Prices and terms are quoted from the vendor's own pages read on 2026-11-03. The registration form, the trial size, the protocol list and the registration class of the ISP addresses were not read, and no address was sampled, so rung 5 is unverified.
